explanation.pt: Revisamos dois tempos do passado: o pretérito perfeito para ações completas ('Ontem eu trabalhei muito') e o pretérito imperfeito para hábitos e cenários ('Quando era criança, eu brincava na rua'). O futuro usa 'ir + infinitivo' ('Vou viajar').
explanation.en: We reviewed two past tenses: the simple past for completed actions ('Ontem eu trabalhei muito' - Yesterday I worked a lot) and the past imperfect for habits and scenes ('Quando era criança, eu brincava na rua' - When I was a child, I played in the street). The future uses 'ir + infinitive' ('Vou viajar' - I am going to travel).
explanation.ar: راجعنا زمنين للماضي: الماضي التام للأفعال المنجزة ('Ontem eu trabalhei muito' - بالأمس عملت كثيرًا) والماضي الناقص للعادات والمشاهد ('Quando era criança, eu brincava na rua' - عندما كنت طفلًا كنت ألعب في الشارع). المستقبل يستخدم 'ir + صيغة المصدر' ('Vou viajar' - سأسافر).

examples.pt: Ontem eu trabalhei muito, mas hoje vou descansar.
examples.en: Yesterday I worked a lot, but today I am going to rest.
examples.ar: بالأمس عملت كثيرًا، لكنني سأستريح اليوم.

examples.pt: Quando eu era pequeno, morava com minha avó.
examples.en: When I was little, I lived with my grandmother.
examples.ar: عندما كنت صغيرًا، كنت أسكن مع جدتي.

examples.en: Tomorrow we are going to visit the museum.

title.pt: Revisão dos Pronomes e do Imperativo
title.en: Review of Pronouns and the Imperative

explanation.pt: Os pronomes oblíquos (me, te, lhe, nos) substituem objetos: 'Eu te vejo', 'Ela me ajudou', 'Nós lhe damos o presente'. O imperativo dá ordens e conselhos: 'Fale devagar', 'Não fume aqui'.
explanation.en: The object pronouns (me, te, lhe, nos) replace objects: 'Eu te vejo' (I see you), 'Ela me ajudou' (She helped me), 'Nós lhe damos o presente' (We give him/her the gift). The imperative gives orders and advice: 'Fale devagar' (Speak slowly), 'Não fume aqui' (Do not smoke here).
explanation.ar: ضمائر المفعول (me، te، lhe، nos) تحل محل المفعول به: 'Eu te vejo' (أراك)، 'Ela me ajudou' (ساعدتني)، 'Nós lhe damos o presente' (نعطيه الهدية). صيغة الأمر تصدر الأوامر والنصائح: 'Fale devagar' (تكلّم ببطء)، 'Não fume aqui' (لا تدخن هنا).

reading.text_pt: O nível A2 termina com muita coisa aprendida. Agora você fala do passado, do futuro e do presente; faz compras, viaja e marca consultas. Você compara coisas, dá conselhos e conta histórias. Parabéns, você está pronto para o próximo nível: B1!
reading.text_en: Level A2 ends with a lot learned. Now you talk about the past, the future and the present; you shop, travel and book appointments. You compare things, give advice and tell stories. Congratulations, you are ready for the next level: B1!
reading.text_ar: ينتهي المستوى A2 وقد تعلّمت الكثير. الآن تتحدث عن الماضي والمستقبل والحاضر؛ تتسوق وتسافر وتحدد المواعيد. تقارن الأشياء وتقدم النصائح وتحكي القصص. مبروك، أنت جاهز للمستوى التالي: B1!

explanation.pt: Ação completa no passado = pretérito perfeito: trabalhei.
explanation.en: Completed action in the past = simple past: trabalhei.
explanation.ar: الفعل المنجز في الماضي = الماضي التام: trabalhei.
